items.title: IT's time to celebrate when chips are down; Nifty IT soars 11.7% to log biggest weekly rally since 2008
items.description: The Indian IT sector experienced an impressive surge, achieving its highest weekly increase in 18 years, driven by unexpectedly strong quarterly results from companies like HCLTech. The Nifty IT index jumped 11.7%, amidst falling semiconductor stock prices in Asia. Furthermore, the rupee showed notable strength, closing below the 95-mark for the first time in 38 days, reflecting the effective measures implemented by the Reserve Bank of India.

items.title: 5 stocks with consistent score improvement and upside potential of up to 29 % in 1 year, according to analysts
items.description: Look at how the market treated the stock of a large FMCG stock – one the best wealth creators of the past – just because it mentioned the risk of rising input costs. It shows what the underlying sentiment on the street is like.

items.title: 8 small, midcap stocks with upside potential of up to 50%. How many are in your portfolio?
items.description: Following an eight-week losing streak in the Nifty, its first such run since 2001, domestic brokerage PL Capital remains cautious on the near-term market outlook. The brokerage does not expect a V-shaped recovery and does not rule out a further decline before the market enters a consolidation phase. The brokerage said the Nifty is currently trading at 15.5 times its one-year forward earnings, a 19.3% discount to its 15-year average price-to-earnings multiple of 19.2 times. Here are 8 small, midcap stocks the brokerage is bullish on.

items.title: Nicholas Sleep’s investing lessons: Why patience, conviction and long-term thinking matter
items.description: Nicholas Sleep’s investment philosophy emphasises independent thinking, patience, and understanding business fundamentals. His successful Nomad Investment Partnership demonstrated the value of identifying high-quality businesses, assessing sustainable competitive advantages, and focusing on long-term value rather than daily price movements. He advocated disciplined research, selective diversification, emotional control, continuous learning, and adapting decisions when circumstances change.

items.title: Concurrent Gainers: 15 stocks gain for 5 days in a row
items.description: Over the five trading sessions ended October 16, the Sensex gained 3.11%, or 2,257 points, to close at 74,729. The benchmark index closed higher in three of the five sessions between October 12 and 16. Amid the broader market rally, around 22 BSE 500 stocks advanced in each of the five consecutive trading sessions. Of these, we identified 15 stocks that gained consistently throughout the period, delivering cumulative returns ranging from 5% to 25%. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: Why India's steel demand is defying global weakness
items.description: India’s steel prices are rising despite weak global markets, supported by infrastructure spending, manufacturing growth and higher input costs. While Chinese oversupply pressures international prices, robust domestic consumption and capacity utilisation underpin India’s outlook, with cheaper imports remaining a key risk.

items.title: Nifty reclaims 200 WMA; eyes further gains as key resistance shapes next move
items.description: Indian equity markets rebounded 2.78%, with the Nifty reclaiming its crucial 200-week moving average. However, weak momentum indicators and overhead resistance warrant caution. Banking, metal, media, pharma and IT stocks show relative strength. Investors should monitor key support levels, prioritise fundamentally strong stocks and maintain disciplined risk management strategies.

items.title: 10 smallcap stocks surge up to 65% in 3 months despite market weakness
items.description: Over the past three months, the Nifty 50 has declined nearly 4%, while the Nifty Smallcap 350 index has shed around 2.5%, reflecting weakness across the broader market. However, the correction has not dampened the momentum in every corner of the small-cap space. Several stocks from the Nifty Smallcap 250 index have defied the broader trend, delivering impressive gains despite market volatility. We highlight 10 stocks that have rallied between 30% and 65% over the past three months.
